title: Remove progress flat exports
summary: Removed the remaining progressView flat window compatibility exports and moved touched consumers to the mediaPipelineProgressView namespace.
reason: WebView flat-export cleanup is active opportunistic remediation. Progress rendering already has a primary namespace, so the flat aliases can be removed while preserving backend-owned mutation boundaries.
behavior_before: progressView.js exported renderProgressBarsInto, renderProgressBars, renderProgressDetails, and renderProgressEvidence as flat window aliases, and several WebView consumers/readiness checks still referenced the flat surface.
behavior_after: Progress helpers are available through window.mediaPipelineProgressView only. App, Queue, Completed, Pending Publish, Rename, Settings, Maintenance, Network, and touched tests use namespace-first progress access; the public contract baseline and global export inventory record zero progress flat exports.
manual_validation: node --check apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/app.js apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/app/home.js apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/completedView.js apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/maintenanceView.js apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/networkView.js apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/pendingPublishView.js apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/progressView.js apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/queueView.summary.js apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/renameView.js apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/settingsView.js - passed as individual node --check invocations

.\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_home_live_state_smoke tests.webview.test_webview_browser_large_table_smoke tests.webview.test_webview_browser_network_smoke tests.webview.test_webview_browser_maintenance_reports_smoke tests.webview.test_webview_browser_rename_smoke tests.webview.test_webview_browser_settings_launch_smoke -q - failed only in tests.webview.test_webview_browser_large_table_smoke after readiness, at existing queue-detail keyboard shortcut focus assertion where queue-detail is display:none inside an evidence panel

.\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_large_table_smoke -q - reproduced the same queue-detail keyboard shortcut focus failure outside the progress namespace readiness gate
rollback_plan: Restore the four progressView.js flat window alias assignments, switch touched consumers and readiness assertions back to flat progress globals, regenerate the WebView public contract/global export inventory/summaries, and rerun the targeted WebView validation ladder.
